positive_cases.name: constrained_delegation_set
positive_cases.scenario: Constrained delegation target list modified on a service account.
positive_cases.rationale: Directory change and delegation attribute selections both match.

positive_cases.name: resource_based_delegation_set
positive_cases.scenario: Resource-based delegation descriptor written on a computer object.
positive_cases.rationale: Directory change and delegation attribute selections both match.

negative_cases.name: display_name_changed
negative_cases.scenario: Display name updated on a service account.
negative_cases.rationale: The delegation attribute selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: computer_account_changed_summary
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: directory_object_read
negative_cases.scenario: Directory object attribute read during an access review.
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier selection does not match a read operation.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
